name: Bus Breakdown and Delays
description:
This dataset records incidents in which New York City school buses broke down or ran late, spanning school years from 2015–2016 onward. Each row represents one incident and includes when it occurred, the borough, the bus company, bus and route numbers, the run type (such as Special Ed AM Run or General Ed AM Run), and the reported reason, with heavy traffic accounting for most delays. It also captures how long the delay lasted, how many students were on board, whether the contractor notified schools and parents, whether the Office of Pupil Transportation was alerted, and whether the incident was classified as a breakdown or a late run. Most rows in this sample come from the 2025–2026 school year.

The data can be used to analyze the frequency and causes of bus disruptions by borough, company, route, or run type; to measure delay lengths and student impact; to evaluate contractor performance and notification practices; and to inform planning or policy decisions aimed at improving school bus reliability
